# qovery_api_token (Data Source)

Reads an existing Qovery API token, without its value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "qovery_api_token" "my_api_token" {
  id              = "<api_token_id>"
  organization_id = "<organization_id>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the API token.
- `organization_id` (String) ID of the organization.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the API token.
- `name` (String) Name of the API token.
- `role_id` (String) ID of the role that sets the permissions of the token, built-in or custom.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Value of the API token. Always `null`: the API returns it only at creation.
